Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Town, shops & places · Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

sign noun

a notice, a board with writing

also notice, signboard, placard, label, notice board, shop sign

classical

Plin. Ep. 7.27.7: lēgit titulum
Liv. 28.46.16 (Lewis & Short)

titulus, titulī m.

noun, second declension

notice, placard, label

The notice put up on a house for sale or to let, the label on a jar, a placard.

Other words

  • tabula, tabulae f. — board; a board with writing on it

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Cic. Caecin. 16 (Lewis & Short: a tablet advertising an auction); M-O s.v. bulletin board: nūntiōrum tabula

    The board itself; a notice board is nūntiōrum tabula (Morgan–Owens).

  • īnscrīptiō, īnscrīptiōnis f. — the writing on something, an inscription

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Dom. 51: nōminis īnscrīptiō (Lewis & Short)

    The wording rather than the board.

Examples

  • Venit Athēnās philosophus Athēnodōrus, lēgit titulum audītōque pretiō …

    the philosopher Athenodorus came to Athens, read the notice, and when he heard the price …Plin. Ep. 7.27.7

See also sign.

SourcesLewis & Short: titulus · Lewis & Short: tabula · Lewis & Short: inscriptio

Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. bulletin board.
